start.title: [TODO:es] The Voice in the Wilderness
start.text:
[TODO:es] John cries by the Jordan:
"Repent, the Kingdom is near."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] He speaks the word of God.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Honor the Prophet
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He is the voice prepared by God.
Lisen humbly.

turn_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Stay at the River
turn_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Your hour begins here.
The Father has called you.

crowds.title: [TODO:es] Among the People
crowds.text:
[TODO:es] Crowds gather along the shore.
They come to be cleansed.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You came to be among them.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk among them as a brother
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You move quietly through the crowd.

apart_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Walk With Them
apart_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] You came to share their humanity.
Walk among them.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk among them as a brother

approach.title: [TODO:es] Toward John
approach.text:
[TODO:es] John stands in the river.
His eyes find yours.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Be Humble
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] You did not come to be honored.
You came to obey.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:es] The Hour Has Come
wait_consequence.text:
El Padre espera este momento.
Ve a Juan.

hesitate.title: La duda de Juan
hesitate.text:
Juan susurra:
«Yo debería ser bautizado por Ti».

choices.text: [TODO:es] "Let it be so to fulfill all."

agree_consequence.title: Cumple el Camino
agree_consequence.text:
Esto debe hacerse en obediencia.
Di la palabra.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "Let it be so to fulfill all."

rebuke_consequence.title: Habla con dulzura
rebuke_consequence.text:
Él es tu precursor.
Respóndele con paz.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "Let it be so to fulfill all."

baptism.title: En el agua
baptism.text:
El río fresco sube.
Inclinas la cabeza.

resist_consequence.title: Ríndete
resist_consequence.text:
Esta es la voluntad del Padre.
Ríndete al momento.

dove.title: Los cielos se abren
dove.text:
El cielo se abre sobre ti.
Una paloma desciende en silencio.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lift your eyes to the Father

hide_consequence.title: Mira hacia arriba
hide_consequence.text:
Tú eres el Hijo Amado.
Recibe el don.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lift your eyes to the Father

boast_consequence.title: Recibe en silencio
boast_consequence.text:
Este momento es sagrado.
Deja que el Espíritu hable.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lift your eyes to the Father

voice.title: La voz del Padre
voice.text:
«Este es Mi Hijo amado,
en quien tengo complacencia».
